## free-tier-llm-landscape
- **What matters:** Recent announcements indicate that Groq, Together, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, and Hugging Face have lowered free‑tier token caps, added stricter request‑rate limits, and introduced “fair‑use” clauses that can suspend access after prolonged high‑volume usage.  
- **Why it matters:** Your autonomous agents rely on uninterrupted, low‑cost inference; tighter caps or sudden throttling can cause task failures, increased latency, or forced model downgrades that degrade code‑generation quality.  
- **One thing worth verifying:** Check the current free‑tier dashboards or provider newsletters for any updated quota numbers or new “burst‑limit” policies that may have taken effect in the last month.
